scope: Synthetic provider/permission/error fixtures; not real phone GPS or live provider verification

checks.name: HTTPS failure distinguished without making GPS/network requests
Permission denial exposes precise code and city-search fallback
Unavailable position and native timeout remain different errors
Synchronous browser location exception is caught and categorized
Missing native callback has a bounded timeout
Cancelling a pending native location prevents any later network request
GPS-to-weather phase updates and source dates stay explicit
NETWORK_UNREACHABLE distinguished from permission errors
Timeout remains bounded even when fetch ignores AbortSignal
Unreadable JSON and provider error are not interpreted as weather
HTTP 429 retains status instead of generic GPS failure
Stale restored work date yields actionable DATE_OUTSIDE_FORECAST
Choosing today succeeds without rewriting old date or storing draft
Future daily forecast remains labelled forecast with existing high rule
City/ZIP search preserves matching ambiguity, coordinates, credentials policy
Cancellation during fetch discards late provider response
Cancel before search/locate never contacts device or provider
Apply and reload write weather key only; no wear/Favorites mutation
Storage write failure is surfaced and previous state retained
No implicit network/location request on construction or stored-state reads
Exact weather eligibility/material/season policy code is preserved
All 705 runtime images and frozen data/engine/renderer files are byte-identical
